name: Five-Day Hypertrophy Split
description: Five long workouts a week for 12 weeks, 9 to 11 exercises each: chest and back, quads and calves, shoulders and arms, a second upper-body day and hamstrings and glutes, so every muscle is trained twice a week. Built for muscle growth with a full gym: barbells, dumbbells, cables and machines. Sets rise from the first block to the second and the weights rise in the third; week 9 is a deload.
